updates.title: TanStack AI Tracing
updates.summary: Available in @arizeai/openinference-tanstack-ai 0.1.0+. A new OpenInference middleware for TanStack AI emits AGENT, LLM, and TOOL spans for chat() calls — covering streaming, non-streaming, and tool-loop flows across any TanStack AI provider adapter.

updates.title: Langfuse Cloud Japan
updates.summary: A new dedicated cloud region in Tokyo keeps traces, prompts, and evaluation data inside Japan.

updates.title: Automatic Issue Detection
updates.summary: New Detect Issues button in traces table uses AI to automatically identify quality problems across correctness, safety, and performance categories in selected traces, linking issues to relevant traces for investigation.

updates.title: Gateway Budget Alerts & Limits
updates.summary: New configurable budget policies for AI Gateway with spending limits by time window, alerts, automatic blocking of costs, and UI for tracking spending and notifications.

updates.title: Trace Graph View
updates.summary: New interactive graph view for traces to visualize multi-level trace hierarchies and parent-child span relationships for debugging complex multi-agent systems.

updates.title: Native OpenTelemetry GenAI Convention Support
updates.summary: Native support for OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions when exporting traces via OTLP with MLFLOW_ENABLE_OTEL_GENAI_SEMCONV enabled, preserving GenAI metadata.

updates.title: OpenCode Tracing Integration
updates.summary: New OpenCode CLI tracing integration for tracking and analyzing code execution flows from terminal-based AI coding assistant.

product_highlights.summary: Continues to offer deeply integrated agent tracing and evaluation for the LangChain ecosystem, with comprehensive nested span visualization natively.
Broadened its framework support by augmenting auto-instrumentation with new TanStack AI Instrumentation for capturing both streaming and non-streaming chat calls.
Standardizes complex evaluation workflows and dataset management through rigorous AI-assisted prompt optimization and custom scorer routing.
Strengthened enterprise data sovereignty and compliance offerings this week by introducing Dedicated Cloud Regions to isolate critical traces, prompts, and evaluation data.
Delivers powerful dashboard analytics and native multimodal tracing, integrating seamlessly with traditional model lifecycle tracking environments.

Released a wave of significant updates this week, enhancing observability and cost controls with a new Trace Graph View, AI-driven failure detection (Detect Issues), GenAI Semantic Conventions for OTEL, and Gateway Budget Policies.

ai_comment.market_trend: The LLM observability market is increasingly prioritizing fine-grained enterprise controls and deep agentic visual debugging, as evidenced by new cost-management gateway policies and specialized trace graph views for complex multi-turn flows.
